title: Apply for a native game bird management (owner/occupier) licence
summary: This page provides information about the native game bird management program, which allows landholders to sustainably manage native game birds on agricultural lands in NSW.
intro:
Native game bird species in NSW can only be hunted under the native game bird management program of the Department of Primary Industries (DPI).

This program allows landholders to sustainably manage native game birds on agricultural lands in NSW.
